description_en: Queries aggregated alert records for a specified entity within a given time range by paging. Records are grouped by rule, attacker IP address, victim IP address, network type, and network instances of both parties
description_zh: 分页查询指定实体在给定时间范围内的告警聚合记录。记录按规则、攻击者 IP、受害者 IP、网络类型及双方网络实例分组
name: DescribeAlertAggAnaIpItemWithEntity

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数，默认 10，最多 100 条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The entity ID. You can obtain this value from ListEntities
parameters.help_zh: 实体 ID，可从 ListEntities 获取
parameters.name: entity_uuid

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. Use this parameter together with ToTime
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳。与 ToTime 一起使用
parameters.name: from_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. The value cannot be earlier than FromTime
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳。不得早于 FromTime
parameters.name: to_time

parameters.help_en: The list of attack results. Valid values: 1: attack attempt. 2: attack succeeded. 3: compromised
parameters.help_zh: 攻击结果列表。1 表示攻击尝试，2 表示攻击成功，3 表示失陷
parameters.name: attack_result

parameters.help_en: The alert rule ID. You can obtain this value from the AlertRuleId field in aggregated alert records
parameters.help_zh: 告警规则 ID。可从告警聚合记录的 AlertRuleId 获取
parameters.name: rule_uuid

parameters.help_en: The attacker or victim IP address. Exact match is used
parameters.help_zh: 攻击者或受害者 IP 地址，采用精确匹配
parameters.name: ip

parameters.help_en: The filter condition for the associated domain of the alerting record
parameters.help_zh: 告警关联域名的筛选条件
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member accounts
parameters.help_zh: 成员账号的阿里云账号 ID
parameters.name: member_uid

parameters.help_en: The list of alert category IDs. You can query these IDs by calling DescribeAlertCategoryList
parameters.help_zh: 告警分类 ID列表。可通过 DescribeAlertCategoryList 查询
parameters.name: category_id

parameters.help_en: The sort order. Valid values: 1: risk level in descending order. 2: latest alert time in descending order. 3: alert count in descending order. 4: first alert time in descending order. Default value: 2
parameters.help_zh: 排序方式。1 表示风险等级降序，2 表示最新告警时点降序，3 表示告警数量降序，4 表示首次告警时点降序；默认 2
parameters.name: order_by

parameters.help_en: The language of the response content. Valid values: zh: Chinese. en: English. Default value: zh
parameters.help_zh: 返回内容的语言。zh 表示中文，en 表示英文，默认中文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The list of alert risk levels. Valid values: 1: low. 2: medium. 3: high
parameters.help_zh: 告警风险等级列表。1 表示低危，2 表示中危，3 表示高危
parameters.name: risk_level

Data.description_en: The query result or operation response data
Data.description_zh: 查询结果或操作返回数据

List.description_en: The list of results on the current page

items.description_en: An aggregated alert record associated with the entity
items.description_zh: 一条实体关联告警聚合记录

AlertBeginTime.description_en: The time when the first alert occurred within the query range. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
AlertBeginTime.description_zh: 查询范围内首次告警发生时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳

AlertEndTime.description_en: The time when the most recent alert occurred within the query range. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
AlertEndTime.description_zh: 查询范围内最近一次告警发生时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳

AlertLogCount.description_en: The number of associated raw alert entries

AlertRuleId.description_en: The alert rule ID. You can obtain this value from alert query results or by calling DescribeAlertRuleBaseMeta
AlertRuleId.description_zh: 告警规则 ID。可从告警查询结果或 DescribeAlertRuleBaseMeta 获取

AttackerDir.description_en: A reserved field that does not return valid values. Do not use this field for any logic. The example value is for documentation format purposes only
AttackerDir.description_zh: 预留返回字段，当前未提供有效值，请勿依赖该字段进行判断。示例仅用于说明文档格式

DominantAttackResult.description_en: The dominant attack result of the aggregated record. The priority order is 3, 2, 1, 5, 6, 7, 8, which is not based on the maximum numeric value. Valid values: 1: attack attempt. 2: attack succeeded. 3: compromised. 5 to 8: other result identifiers
DominantAttackResult.description_zh: 聚合记录的主要攻击结果，选择优先顺序为 3、2、1、5、6、7、8；不是取最大数值。1 表示攻击尝试，2 表示攻击成功，3 表示失陷，5～8 为其他结果标识

EngineTypeList.description_en: A reserved field that does not return valid values. Do not use this field to determine the alert source
EngineTypeList.description_zh: 预留返回字段，当前未提供有效值，请勿依赖该字段判断告警来源

items.description_en: A reserved field that does not return valid values. Do not use this field for any logic. The example value is for documentation format purposes only
items.description_zh: 预留返回字段，当前未提供有效值，请勿依赖该字段进行判断。示例仅用于说明文档格式

MemberUid.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member accounts
MemberUid.description_zh: 成员账号的阿里云账号 ID

NetConnectDir.description_en: A reserved field that does not return valid values. Do not use this field for any logic. The example value is for documentation format purposes only
NetConnectDir.description_zh: 预留返回字段，当前未提供有效值，请勿依赖该字段进行判断。示例仅用于说明文档格式

NetType.description_en: The network type of the alert traffic. Valid values: 0: public network. 1: private network
NetType.description_zh: 告警流量的网络类型。0 表示公网，1 表示私网

OffenderIp.description_en: The IP address of the attacker

OffenderVpcInstanceId.description_en: The VPC instance ID of the attacker
OffenderVpcInstanceId.description_zh: 攻击者所在的 VPC 实例 ID

RiskLevel.description_en: The alert risk level. Valid values: 1: low. 2: medium. 3: high
RiskLevel.description_zh: 告警风险等级。1 表示低危，2 表示中危，3 表示高危

VictimIp.description_en: The IP address of the victim

VictimVpcInstanceId.description_en: The VPC instance ID of the victim
VictimVpcInstanceId.description_zh: 受害者所在的 VPC 实例 ID

PageNumber.description_en: The current page number. Pages start from 1

PageSize.description_en: The number of records per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
PageSize.description_zh: 每页记录数，默认 10，最多 100 条

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of records that match the query conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合查询条件的记录总数

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request failed

Message.description_en: The description of the request result or the failure reason
Message.description_zh: 请求结果说明或失败原因

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于排查请求问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values: true: The request was successful. false: The request failed
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。true 表示成功，false 表示失败
